title: Yummy Pink Vietnamese Tofu Salad
description: A bright, cultured and crumbly salad featuring pink tofu and crisp veggies, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Toss tofu cubes with pink food coloring and olive oil until evenly coated.
Place tofu in the air fryer basket and cook for 10 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crisp.
Combine shredded carrot, sliced cucumber, and red cabbage in a large bowl.
Whisk together tamari sauce, lime juice, toasted sesame oil, and minced garlic and ginger to make the dressing.
Add cooked millet noodles to the vegetable mix and drizzle dressing over the mixture, tossing to coat.
Remove tofu from the air fryer and let cool for 2 minutes before adding to the salad.
Gently fold tofu into the salad until evenly distributed.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top and give one final gentle toss.
Serve immediately on a talavera plate for a colorful presentation.
